# High-edge coherent-preamble recording

English · [简体中文](说明.md)

This is actual AIO2 background plus a Pager transmission at nominal −9 dBm. Six preamble chirps had coherence approximately 0.872, mean evidence 11.42 dB and minimum 7.17 dB; the quarter-SFD evidence was approximately 5.36 dB. The old v3 per-symbol 11 dB / quarter-ending 7 dB gates missed it.

The diagnostic fit used known bandwidth/spreading factor. It is not a blind-detection result. Any revised criterion must search the complete supported BW/SF space and reject incorrect synchronization, malformed SFD and interference controls. Payload bytes and CRC were not verified. Original hashes, source coordinates and generation/crop provenance are in `provenance.json`.
